name: Scarecrow
def: Stripped down mobility twin of Curiosity built at reduced mass so its Earth weight matches the flight rover's weight on Mars.
body: Scarecrow has Curiosity's suspension, wheels and drive actuators but no onboard computer, arm or instruments, which is where its nickname comes from. Because Martian gravity is about 38 percent of Earth's, building the testbed at roughly a third of Curiosity's mass makes its wheel loads on Earth match those of the flight rover on Mars. JPL drives it in the Mars Yard and on the Dumont dunes in California to check slopes, sand traps and wheel wear before commanding the real rover.
facts: Mass tuned so Earth tests reproduce Martian wheel loading
Used to test escape routes from soft sand before commanding Curiosity
specs: Six wheel rocker bogie drive matching the flight rover
External umbilical or battery power during tests
Instrumented wheels with motion tracking during trials
